item.title: Site Criticism Team - Staff Review
item.content:encoded:
So, I've been sitting on this one for a few days to really collect my thoughts on why I didn't care for this one so much. I also apologize for double posting in the discussion here, but a Site Crit review warrants a fresh post. On the whole, I'm a fan of the Serpent's Hand and I like their format as well, but I think that's where I draw my main criticisms with this.

Firstly, I dislike the creative choice you made to only have one unnamed editor on the document. Their personality isn't strong or fleshed out because there isn't anybody else for them to bounce off of, and so that really neuters what is often (in my opinion) the best part of a Serpent's Hand format.

Secondly, I just found myself disinterested with the subject. For all intents and purposes, this is a beat for beat transfiguration of SCP-2300, just from the Hand's perspective instead of the Foundation's. We don't get a whole lot of new info over the SCP, and there really isn't much of an implicit or explicit plot either to further carry my attention and enjoyment.

The above led me to a rather strong downvote. This just feels like it didn't capture what is so good about the SH format, and instead just treated it as a different way to write an SCP.

Disclaimer: Opinions expressed in this review do not reflect the opinions of SCP Wiki staff as a whole. Please respond to TheMightyMcB or contact the captain of the Site Criticism Team, SoullessSingularity, for any questions or concerns relating to this review.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
Hey author, if you want this article to look like the other Serpent's Hand entries, you'll probably want to use their CSS theme. There are 2 choices you have to do this: the Sigma-9 SH theme and the Black Highlighter SH theme.

To add the standard theme, as seen in articles like The Amazonian Hind, just add the following to the top of your article:

[[include :scp-wiki:component:sh-theme]]

To add the Black Highlighter Dustjacket theme, as seen in articles like Karcist Halyna Ieva, or The Mother Who Demands One's Toes, just add the following to the top of your article:

[[include :scp-wiki:component:black-highlighter-theme-dev]]
[[include :scp-wiki:component:dustjacket-theme]]
